subject: reasoning
question:
A cube is made by folding the given sheet. In the cube so formed, which letter will be on the face opposite to the face having the letter 'Q'?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81579985f8af7d83f754707729d7b0906ec83737fbc21416fac80f61b22ea653.png]
solution:
Faces opposite to each other is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98fdb0685096ac6a5e5345833d243d27f06b347145f49850934f02b0ab496bfc.png] 

Clearly, letter U will be on the face opposite to the face having the letter Q.

Hence, '**U**' is the correct answer.
